changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientchargeslog AS SELECT pcl.id, pcl.patient_charge_id, pcl.patient_id, pcl.encounter_id, pcl.plan_id, pcl.action, pcl.due_amount, pcl.remaining, pcl.currency, pcl.facility_default_currency, pcl.created_date, pcl.last_modified_date, pcl.payload FROM public.patient_charges_log pcl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientchargeslog TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientchargeslog FROM report_user;
